# Example

> Example is a <one sentence on what your product does>. This file tells AI agents what Example is and where its machine-readable, read-only public data lives.

## What an agent can do here

Example exposes a small, read-only public surface. No authentication is required for the endpoints listed below, and they return only aggregate, non-personal data. A machine-readable description of this surface is published as an OpenAPI document.

- [OpenAPI description](https://example.com/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable spec for Example's public, read-only endpoints.
- [Aggregate public status (JSON)](https://example.com/api/status): Returns aggregate, non-personal public data. No authentication required. Response is cached and refreshed periodically; see `asOf` for the snapshot time.

## MCP endpoint (for agents)

Example serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing:

- `get_status` (free) — Returns Example's public, read-only aggregate data. Read-only, no authentication, aggregate (non-personal) data only.

Run it locally over stdio (see `mcp/README.md`), or host it over Streamable HTTP and advertise the URL here once it is live.
